item.tib: khrid gdams bdun pa byin rlabs bdag 'jug gsol 'debs gyi khrid rim
item.coloph: ces pa 'di yang / dmar khrid dug lnga rang grol zhes bya ba/ sngon 'gro khrid kyi rim pa 'di ni/ rig 'dzin gong ma'i gsungs rgyun dang / rgyud gzhan gyi nang nas med pa yi/ che bcos 'di ni gang dran gang shar gyi phyir du/ dus mtha'i blo dman 'ga' la phan phyir du/ khyung ka (dkar) ru'i dge sbyong tis Ta rad Na'i ming can gyis/ shing lug zla ba bdun pa'i tshes brgyad bzang po la/ 'dzam gling gangs rgyal ti se'i g.yas phyogs/ slob dpon dam pa 'bum rje'i sgrub phug g.yung drung gsal ba 'od 'phro zhes bya ba de ru brtsams pa dge/ 'di brtsam nyes 'gal gang dang gang byung yang / skyabs gnas yul mchog tshogs la mthol lo bshags/ skal ldan sangs rgyas thob pa'i cha rkyen shog skal med log rta'i srog gi spu grir shog dge ba 'di yis 'gro ba ma lus pa/ thams cad sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyu ru bsngo//
